Indah bahkan tidak ingin lagi menjadi mekanik Geri dan memutuskan untuk membatalkan keikutsertaannya dalam balapan drag nasional.

programme.title: Temen Ngekost S1 E5

Kai pun berusaha membuat video tentang kehidupan sekitarnya dengan merekam semua momen yang ada di Kostan South House.

programme.title: Temen Ngekost S1 E6

programme.title: Temen Ngekost S1 E7

programme.title: Temen Ngekost S1 E9

programme.desc: Prajurit Tuan Chang Qing bertemu wanita penghibur Liu Yin Xi di sebuah kota kecil. Liu meminta Tuan untuk membunuh Guo Tian Sheng, yang dikenal sebagai 'Dokter Pembunuh', untuk membalas kematian tunangannya.

programme.title: Let's Fall In Love
programme.desc: Film komedi romantis yang dibintangi artis legendaris Lin Feng Jiao ini menceritakan kisah cinta yang tak biasa antara putra seorang pengusaha dan keponakan perempuan dari seorang kepala sekolah taman kanak-kanak.

programme.title: The Voyage Of Emperor...
programme.desc: Kaisar Chieng Lung sering memalsukan identitasnya untuk berbaur dengan rakyat saat melakukan perjalanan tanpa memberitahu siapa pun tentang identitas aslinya.

programme.title: The Casino
programme.desc: Setelah terpisah selama beberapa tahun, pasangan kekasih Lily Ho dan Yueh Hua bertemu di sebuah kasino dan mereka bersumpah untuk menghancurkan para jenderal militer korup, penjahat dan pemeras!

programme.title: The Swordmates
programme.desc: Li meminta Wang, rekannya yang terpercaya untuk melindungi keluarganya saat ia pergi. Namun Wang memperkosa istrinya, membunuh pelayannya dan menyerang rombongan Li. Li khawatir jika putrinya masih berada dalam bahaya!

programme.title: 7-Man Army
programme.desc: Pada tahun 1933, 20.000 tentara dan 50 tank Jepang menyerbu Tembok Besar Tiongkok.

programme.title: Hell Has No Boundary
programme.desc: Seorang polisi wanita bernama May kembali bertugas setelah mengalami hal yang tak terduga dalam perjalanan berkemah. Namun, ia justru mengalami kejadian-kejadian aneh dan terus diintai oleh maut.

programme.title: The Eunuch
programme.desc: Sebelum menyutradari Bruce Lee dalam film Fist Of Fury, Lo Wei telah menulis dan membintangi film yang mengisahkan seorang pengkhianat yang rela membunuh Kaisar demi merebut kekuasaan tertinggi ini.

programme.title: Forever Diamonds
programme.desc: Penipu cantik bernama Hua mencuri sebuah cincin berlian dari toko di Hong Kong dan kabur ke Singapura. Untuk menghindari bea cukai, ia memasukkan cincin itu ke dalam saku pria asing, tapi ia kehilangan jejaknya.

programme.title: Mr. Funnybone
programme.desc: Saksikan kelucuan Funny Bone saat ia berusaha memenangkan hati seorang wanita tangguh. Bersama dengan sahabat karibnya, Big Potato, seorang lelaki gagah yang selalu mengalami berbagai hal konyol.

programme.title: Mr. Funnybone Strikes Again
programme.desc: Big Potato membuka sebuah klinik Tiongkok kuno, namun metode tradisionalnya ditolak oleh masyarakat Hong Kong modern yang skeptis. Ia meminta sahabatnya, Mr. Funnybone, untuk membantu menyelamatkan kliniknya.

programme.title: The Kid With The Golden Arm
programme.desc: Pemerintah mempekerjakan Yang untuk mengawal muatan emas ke daerah yang dilanda kelaparan. Geng Chi Sha, dengan salah satu petarung terbaik mereka, Golden Arm, berniat melakukan pembajakan dan membunuh karyawan Yang.

programme.title: Mr. Virgin
programme.desc: Ketika seorang pemuda mengabaikan peringatan seorang ahli feng shui dan memutuskan untuk menikah sebelum berusia 30 tahun, serangkaian kesialan mulai mengutuk hidupnya.

programme.title: The Viral Factor
programme.desc: Agen Jon mempertimbangkan untuk meninggalkan kepolisian sampai dia mengetahui bahwa saudara laki-lakinya bekerja sebagai tentara bayaran untuk mantan rekan kerjanya yang mengkhianati tim mereka.

programme.title: The Accidental Spy
programme.desc: Di sebuah pusat perbelanjaan di Hong Kong, intuisi Buck Yuen (Jackie Chan) memperingatkannya. Ia menyelamatkan hasil rampasan perampokan dan muncul di televisi, akhirnya sampai di Istanbul melalui Korea Selatan, dan tanpa sengaja menjadi mata-mata. Untungnya, ia menguasai Kung Fu.

programme.title: Mr. Vampire 3
programme.desc: Seorang pendeta Tao dan para pendamping rohnya harus berpisah setelah ia memutuskan untuk membantu seorang pemburu vampir, yang ingin mengalahkan seorang penyihir jahat dan para pengikutnya.

programme.title: How To Choose A Royal Bride
programme.desc: Kaisar muda Kangxi sedang berusaha memilih seorang istri. Ibunya telah mengatur agar beberapa wanita muda yang tersedia mengunjunginya sehingga ia dapat memilih.

programme.title: Fist Of Legend
programme.desc: Saat belajar di Jepang, Chen Zhen menemukan beberapa pelajar asal Tiongkok menghilang dan tanpa sengaja mengungkap sejumlah konspirasi kelompok Naga Hitam.

programme.title: Lost Memories
programme.desc: Sebuah upaya pembunuhan yang gagal di Harbin, Cina pada tahun 1909 mengubah arah sejarah. Kini dua agen JBI harus menemukan hubungan antara benda tersebut dengan sebuah artefak Korea kuno.

programme.title: Girl With The Diamond Slipper
programme.desc: Lily, adalah seorang gadis biasa yang menjalani kehidupan sederhana. Suatu hari, dalam sebuah pasar antik, dia menemukan sepasang sepatu kaca berlian yang indah. Tanpa disangka, sepatu ini ternyata memiliki kekuatan magis yang dapat mewujudkan impian dan memberikan keberuntungan. Ketika Lily mencoba sepatu tersebut, dia segera menemukan bahwa hidupnya mulai berubah drastis. Dia mendapatkan pekerjaan impiannya, bertemu dengan orang-orang penting, dan bahkan menarik perhatian seorang pangeran modern yang tampan.

programme.title: Song Of The Assassins
programme.desc: Seorang pembunuh mengemban misi pertamanya sambil diam-diam menyelidiki penyebab pembantaian keluarganya beberapa tahun silam. Namun, ia malah terjerat dalam suatu konspirasi politik saat menjalankan misi.

programme.title: The Comeback
programme.desc: Paman Hua adalah pensiunan agen yang memiliki toko barang antik di sebuah jalan tua. Namun, jalan itu dihancurkan secara paksa oleh Geng Naga Hijau setempat, dan membuat identitas Paman Hua tak sengaja terungkap.

programme.title: Infernal Affairs 3
programme.desc: 10 bulan setelah Yan terbunuh, Ming dipindahkan untuk bekerja di bagian administrasi. Sementara itu, seorang bintang baru, Wing muncul di kepolisian. Ming mencurigainya sebagai mata-mata yang diutus oleh triad.

programme.title: Lifeline
programme.desc: Film ini berkisah tentang seorang pemadam kebakaran yang rela menerjang bahaya dan mempertaruhkan nyawanya demi menyelamatkan orang lain. Akan tetapi, apakah ia memiliki keberanian untuk menghadapi masalah pribadinya?

programme.title: Maoshan Heavenly Master
programme.desc: Tn. Zhang diusir dari klannya setelah tahanan Chi melarikan diri di bawah pengawasannya. Lalu, Tn. Zhang datang ke sebuah lokasi tempat hilangnya sejumlah orang dan menemukan bahwa Chi lah yang menangkap mereka.

programme.title: Unbeatable
programme.desc: Fai, yang pernah menjadi juara dunia tinju, melarikan diri ke Makau dari rentenir dan secara tak terduga bertemu Qi, seorang pemuda yang bertekad memenangkan pertandingan tinju.

programme.title: Open The Coffin
programme.desc: Sebuah film misteri supranatural dengan seorang detektif yang menyelidiki pembunuhan yang tampaknya merupakan akibat dari kutukan.

programme.title: 2025/2026 (Haaland) : Goals Of The Season
programme.desc: From free-kicks to solo runs, scissor kicks to 30-yard screamers, Goals of the Season revisits some of the most memorable strikes from the 25/26 campaign, whilst paying homage to the Golden Boot winner.

programme.title: The Great North London Divide : PL Stories
programme.desc: Set against one of the most dramatic seasons in recent memory, we explore the enduring intensity of the North London rivalry between Arsenal and Tottenham Hotspur. We trace the origins of a feud shaped by geography, identity and decades of defining moments. We interweave the story of this season, which has reshaped the balance of power in North London and brings a fresh perspective to a rivalry already steeped in history. Through iconic matches and unforgettable characters, we capture what this rivalry has meant; and what it could become, as the two clubs look ahead to an uncertain future that may yet see them competing in very different circumstances.

programme.title: Patrick Vieira : The Big Interview
programme.desc: From street football in Senegal to becoming Arsenal captain, Patrick Vieira reflects on the journey that shaped one of the league's most iconic figures, as he tells Steve Bower about the proudest chapter of his career: the 2003-04 Invincibles season.

programme.title: Review
programme.desc: A comprehensive recap of each match week, delivered within hours of the final fixture of the round.

programme.title: The Season So Far : The Catch-Up Show
programme.desc: We look back at all the very best moments of the 2026/2027 season?so?far. An action-packed show filled with exciting Premier League programming and digital content.

programme.title: Granit Xhaka : PL Stories
programme.desc: From his family's courageous journey in search of a better future to becoming one of Europe's most respected midfielders, this is the story of Granit Xhaka. We chart his rise through the game, the highs and lows of a career that tested his resilience, and the turbulent relationship with Arsenal supporters that ultimately became one of football's greatest redemption?stories. Now in love with the game again at Sunderland, Xhaka's story proves that perseverance can define a legacy as much as success

programme.title: 2025/2026 (Ars) : Review Of The Season
programme.desc: As we wave goodbye to another action-packed and compelling Premier League campaign, Review of the Season takes you through the twists and turns of a gripping last 10 months. From how the title was won, the fight for European spots, and the battle to avoid relegation - all the key moments are covered from another scintillating season.

programme.title: (Subbed) Pep - The Legacy : PL Stories
programme.desc: As Manchester City embark on a new chapter, we celebrate the extraordinary legacy of Pep Guardiola, the visionary who transformed not only a football club, but the Premier League itself. From his formative years as a player and coach to redefining excellence in English football, we trace the journey that made him one of the greatest managers the game has ever seen. Through unprecedented success, relentless innovation and a lasting influence on generations to come, this is the story of the man who changed the standards by which every Premier League manager is measured.

programme.title: (Subbed) Roberto Mancini : PL Stories
programme.desc: From a celebrated playing career in Italy to becoming the man who transformed Manchester City into Premier League champions, Roberto Mancini's footballing life has been filled with triumph, drama and unforgettable characters. PL Stories explores his fiery relationship with Mario Balotelli, 'that' extraordinary final-day victory over QPR, and the deep friendship he shared with the late Gianluca Vialli. Mancini's interview is brutally honest, highlighting the defining moments and extraordinary career of one of football's most compelling characters.

programme.title: The Centre Back With Joleon Lescott : The Art Of...
programme.desc: Once the unsung workhorses of English football, centre-backs have become some of the Premier League's most influential figures. Joleon breaks down some of the key attributes of the role, and examines how the duties of the centre-back have expanded over time.

programme.desc: John Stones has experienced almost everything the game can offer; from the pressure of the biggest stage to the injuries and setbacks that have tested him along the way. programme.title: Mci V Qpr 11/12 : Rewind

Shaun Wright-Phillips and Joleon Lescott offer the perspective from both sides, with the final day drama at the Etihad set in the context of Manchester City's Run-In and their pursuit of a first Premier League Title.

programme.title: Yaya Toure: Man City 13/14 : Rewind
programme.desc: Yaya Toure is widely regarded as one of the Premier League's most complete midfielders. He was at the peak of his powers in 2013/14, hitting 20 league goals en route to his second league title with Manchester City. The Ivorian shares his memories of the key matches and goals from that campaign.

programme.title: Goalkeeping With Petr Cech : The Art Of...
programme.desc: Legendary goalkeeper, Petr Cech, sits down with Will Perry to discuss the role of the goalkeeper in the Premier League and how it has changed over the years. Cech gives his unique insight into the mentality of a goalkeeper and reflects on his career before breaking down and analysing some of the key attributes that make a great goalkeeper. He also selects five iconic Premier League goalkeepers to build his dream keeper for the modern game.

programme.title: Petr Cech : PL Stories
programme.desc: One of the Premier League's greatest-ever goalkeepers, Petr Cech's career was nearly changed forever by the horrific head injury he suffered in 2006. We sit down with him to discuss his remarkable recovery and journey back to the very top, before discovering how his competitive drive has continued, with the Czech shot stopper swapping football for a new challenge playing Ice Hockey.

programme.title: John Stones : PL Stories
programme.desc: John Stones has experienced almost everything the game can offer; from the pressure of the biggest stage to the injuries and setbacks that have tested him along the way. After more than a decade at the heart of the Premier League, winning its biggest honours and helping redefine the role of a modern defender, he now takes his career in a new direction.?As Stones begins a new life in Italy, we look back at the defining moments, relationships and challenges behind one of England's most decorated players.

programme.title: (Subbed) Roberto Mancini : PL Stories
programme.desc: From a celebrated playing career in Italy to becoming the man who transformed Manchester City into Premier League champions, Roberto Mancini's footballing life has been filled with triumph, drama and unforgettable characters. PL Stories explores his fiery relationship with Mario Balotelli, 'that' extraordinary final-day victory over QPR, and the deep friendship he shared with the late Gianluca Vialli. Mancini's interview is brutally honest, highlighting the defining moments and extraordinary career of one of football's most compelling characters.

programme.title: (Subbed) Pep - The Legacy : PL Stories
programme.desc: As Manchester City embark on a new chapter, we celebrate the extraordinary legacy of Pep Guardiola, the visionary who transformed not only a football club, but the Premier League itself. From his formative years as a player and coach to redefining excellence in English football, we trace the journey that made him one of the greatest managers the game has ever seen. Through unprecedented success, relentless innovation and a lasting influence on generations to come, this is the story of the man who changed the standards by which every Premier League manager is measured.

programme.title: Yaya Toure: Man City 13/14 : Rewind
programme.desc: Yaya Toure is widely regarded as one of the Premier League's most complete midfielders. He was at the peak of his powers in 2013/14, hitting 20 league goals en route to his second league title with Manchester City. The Ivorian shares his memories of the key matches and goals from that campaign.

programme.title: Robbie Fowler: My Liverpool Years : Rewind
programme.desc: Adored by Liverpool fans around the world, Robbie Fowler is one of the Premier League's all-time greats. The local lad reflects on his remarkable journey, from his prolific breakthrough at Anfield, to an unprecedented cup treble and an emotional homecoming on Merseyside.

programme.title: The Great North London Divide : PL Stories
programme.desc: Set against one of the most dramatic seasons in recent memory, we explore the enduring intensity of the North London rivalry between Arsenal and Tottenham Hotspur. We trace the origins of a feud shaped by geography, identity and decades of defining moments. We interweave the story of this season, which has reshaped the balance of power in North London and brings a fresh perspective to a rivalry already steeped in history. Through iconic matches and unforgettable characters, we capture what this rivalry has meant; and what it could become, as the two clubs look ahead to an uncertain future that may yet see them competing in very different circumstances.

programme.title: Peter & Kasper Schmeichel : The Big Interview
programme.desc: Sharing 6 Premier League trophies between them, Peter and Kasper Schmeichel can be classed individually amongst the best goalkeepers of the Premier League era. This week, the Big Interview takes the rare opportunity of having father and son together. The pair discuss their fascinating dynamic, a relationship that developed from Kasper's formative years growing up around a father who won 5 Premier League titles in a dominant Manchester United side. The pair then share incredible insight around the evolution of the art of goalkeeping, spanning their own careers to the present day.

programme.title: Goalkeeping With Petr Cech : The Art Of...
programme.desc: Legendary goalkeeper, Petr Cech, sits down with Will Perry to discuss the role of the goalkeeper in the Premier League and how it has changed over the years. Cech gives his unique insight into the mentality of a goalkeeper and reflects on his career before breaking down and analysing some of the key attributes that make a great goalkeeper. He also selects five iconic Premier League goalkeepers to build his dream keeper for the modern game.

We sit down with him to discuss his remarkable recovery and journey back to the very top, before discovering how his competitive drive has continued, with the Czech shot stopper swapping football for a new challenge playing Ice Hockey.

programme.title: Per Tutta La Vita
programme.desc: Empat pasangan suami istri mengetahui bahwa pernikahan mereka tidak sah karena dinikahkan oleh seorang pria yang ternyata bukan pendeta sungguhan. Keempat kisah tersebut saling berkaitan, dan mereka harus memutuskan langkah selanjutnya, apakah akan menikah kembali atau tidak.

programme.title: Christmas Ranch
programme.desc: Saat kembali ke peternakan sang kakek menjelang Natal, seorang gadis remaja mengetahui bahwa usaha keluarga sedang menghadapi kesulitan yang mengancam masa depannya. Bertekad mempertahankan warisan tersebut, ia bekerja sama dengan keluarga sambil menghadapi berbagai tantangan dan mempererat kembali hubungan yang sempat merenggang. Dengan latar pedesaan yang hangat, kisah persahabatan dengan kuda, serta semangat kebersamaan di musim Natal, Christmas Ranch menyuguhkan drama keluarga yang penuh inspirasi tentang harapan, ketekunan, dan arti sebuah rumah.

programme.title: Direct Action
programme.desc: Frank Gannon, seorang polisi veteran, sedang diburu oleh rekan-rekan polisi setelah mereka mengetahui bahwa dia telah mengkhianati persaudaraan dan mengungkap korupsi skala besar FBI di LAPD. Dia punya satu hari tersisa untuk membuktikan kasusnya dan bertahan hidup.

programme.title: Outrage
programme.desc: Perintah seorang pemimpin yakuza untuk mempererat hubungan dengan kelompok rival justru memicu konflik yang semakin membesar. Otomo, seorang eksekutor berpengalaman, harus bertahan di tengah intrik, pengkhianatan, dan pertumpahan darah ketika setiap faksi berusaha memperluas pengaruhnya. Dengan atmosfer yang tegang dan penuh aksi, Outrage menyuguhkan thriller kriminal yang mengupas ambisi, loyalitas, serta kerasnya kehidupan di balik dunia organisasi kejahatan Jepang.

programme.title: The Ex Next Door
programme.desc: Cinta Katie Gatewood kepada suaminya, Dan, diuji ketika mantan pacar Dan yang terobsesi, Louisa, pindah ke rumah sebelah, dengan maksud untuk memisahkan pasangan bahagia itu dengan segala cara.

programme.title: A Boy Called Po
programme.desc: A Boy Called Po mengisahkan David Wilson, seorang ayah yang harus membesarkan putranya Patrick, atau yang biasa dipanggil Po, setelah istrinya meninggal dunia. Po adalah seorang anak dengan spektrum autisme yang memiliki cara unik dalam melihat dan memahami dunia di sekitarnya. Di tengah kesedihan, tekanan hidup, dan tantangan sebagai orang tua tunggal, David berusaha memberikan yang terbaik untuk putranya. Perjalanan mereka mengajarkan arti kasih sayang, penerimaan, kesabaran, dan kekuatan hubungan antara ayah dan anak.

programme.desc: Sebuah film komedi tentang seorang pria, sahabatnya, dan wanita yang mereka berdua kagumi, yang menyaksikan hidup mereka berlalu begitu saja.

Namun, salah satu dari mereka, yang curiga dan sangat sulit diprediksi, bersedia melakukan apa saja untuk mendapatkan uang itu.

programme.desc: Wicaksana atau Wicak sedang mencari ibunya di desa. Namun ia bertemu dengan Nindi, penjaga villa tempatnya menginap. Wicak dan Nindi bersama keliling desa mencari informasi tentang ibunya. Dalam perjalanannya Wicak dan Nindi menemukan kenyamanan satu-sama lain.

programme.title: Cinta Dua Pilihan
programme.desc: Fathir dan Sukma adalah sepasang suami istri yang hidup sederhana namun bahagia. Sampai akhirnya sang buah hati Zahra divonis menderita sakit yang serius ditengah keluarga mereka yang masih serba kekurangan. Disaat bersamaan, Fathir tidak sengaja bertemu dengan mantannya Clara. Kehadiran Clara mengubah segalanya.

programme.title: Naik Ranjang
programme.desc: Setelah terpisah selama 20 tahun, Tyas berusaha mencari ayahnya, Mahdi, untuk menjadi wali pernikahannya dengan Gino. Setelah bertemu Mahdi, tunangan Tyas, Gino tampak terkejut menemukan Hani, adik Tyas yang telah memiliki anak dari hubungan mereka di masa lalu.

programme.title: Kami Tidak Bercerita, Tau Tau Naik Pelaminan Aja
programme.desc: Nadin (Shanice Margaretha) seorang gadis pekerja keras dan mandiri, merasa hidupnya baik-baik saja sebelum ia bertemu Azril (El Ryan Carlen). Nadin yang bekerja di sebuah perusahaan, suatu waktu tanpa sengaja bertemu dengan Azril yang menyebalkan. Mereka terlibat percekcokan. Tanpa sengaja saat ada acara, mereka tanpa sengaja tidur bersebelahan di tempat yang sama

programme.title: Dokter Cuek, Perawat Gaspol
programme.desc: Fajar (Ridho Illahi) dokter muda yang sedang didesak keluarganya untuk membantu sang kakak untuk mengelola perusahaan. Fajar diminta ibunya untuk berhenti menjadi dokter. Fajar yang tak bisa memenuhi permintaan ibunya, mengatakan bahwa dokter adalah impiannya. Perubahan hidup Fajar berubah saat Fajar bertemu Maya (Amanda Salmakhira) perawat cantik.

programme.title: Bidadari Surgamu
programme.desc: Menceritakan kisah seorang gadis bernama Sakinah yang menjalani hidup penuh tekanan karena fitnah dan dipaksa menikah dengan orang yang tidak mencintainya. Tidak hanya itu, Sakinah bahkan dihalangi untuk tau siapa Ibu kandung yang tega membuangnya. Bagaimana kelanjutan kisah hidup Sakinah?

programme.title: Waktu Ku Kecil Ku Tak Tahu Yang Mungil-Mungil
programme.desc: Anet selalu menjadi korban bully karena kondisi perekonomian yang sulit. Hal itulah yang membuatnya memutuskan untuk pindah sekolah.Di hari pertamanya masuk sekolah, ada sebuah peristiwa yang membuat Anet telat masuk sekolah. Ia pun terburu-buru masuk kelas hingga menabrak siswi lainnya. Sesampainya di kelas, ia bertemu dengan seorang pemuda tampan bernama Raska. Raska pun terkesan dengan siswi pindahan tersebut meski Anet terlihat canggung dan tidak percaya diri saat memperkenalkan diri di depan kelas. Keduanya pun menjadi dekat apalagi setelah Anet tahu bahwa Raska dipaksa orang tuanya untuk kuliah di jurusan bisnis, padahal Raska sebenarnya ingin kuliah di jurusan seni. Lama kelamaan timbul rasa cinta di antara keduanya, meski ternyata ibunya Raska tidak menyukainya karena Anet itu dari keluarga miskin.

programme.title: Tanpa Miss Bule, Aku Awut Awutan
programme.desc: Terkendala bahasa, Gilang meminta Kinan mengajarinya bahasa inggris untuk bisa menyusul pacarnya ke Australia. Meski awalnya menolak, Kinan yang dijuluki Gilang sebagai Miss Bule, akhirnya bersedia menjadi guru les bahasa Inggris Gilang. Di saat Gilang akhirnya bertemu lagi dengan pacarnya, Kinan ternyata cemburu.

programme.title: Bidadari Surgamu

programme.title: Ini Asli Bang Strawberry Apa Paksu?
programme.desc: Pada suatu hari, Rena yang bekerja di kebun strawberry milik ayahnya, dipaksa untuk bertunangan dengan Dimas hingga ia kabur. Saat Rena kabur, tanpa sengaja ia masuk ke mobil milik Bara, seorang anak konglomerat yang tengil dan berbuat seenaknya sendiri. Bara yang sedang mengemudi, kaget ketika mengetahui keberadaan Rena di dalam mobilnya. Bara segera menghentikan mobilnya. Bara menuduh Rena adalah seorang pembegal mobil. Rena tidak terima. Keduanya terlibat percekcokan. Kemudian, Bara yang diminta papanya untuk mendapatkan kebun strawberry milik ayah Rena, terpaksa harus mendekati Rena. Awalnya Bara dan Rena sering cekcok, tapi lama kelamaan Bara mulai menyukai Rena yang baik hati, padahal ia sudah punya tunangan bernama Sheila.

programme.title: Cinta Setelah Cinta S2
programme.desc: Cinta Setelah Cinta bercerita tentang kehidupan sebuah keluarga yang terlihat sempurna ternyata menyimpan sebuah rahasia memilukan. Merasa beruntung memiliki suami seperti Niko seorang pengusaha sukses dan seorang anak perempuan Audrey, kini Starla harus menelan kepahitan atas perselingkuhan Niko dengan teman sekolah mereka berdua yakni Ayu

programme.title: Ku Terpikat Sama Cewek Kemaling Sole
programme.desc: Mila adalah cewek cantik yang menjadi pencopet untuk bisa mendapatkan uang. Namun apes, Mila ketahuan ketika ingin mencopet di angkot

programme.title: Frasier S7, Ep 11
programme.desc: Frasier Season 7 mengikuti kehidupan Dr. Frasier Crane, seorang psikiater yang bekerja sebagai penyiar radio, saat menghadapi berbagai masalah dalam pekerjaan, keluarga, persahabatan, dan hubungan asmara. Bersama saudaranya Niles, ayahnya Martin, Daphne, dan Roz, Frasier menghadapi berbagai situasi kocak seputar cinta, pernikahan, pekerjaan, konflik keluarga, dan usahanya mengendalikan kehidupan yang semakin rumit.

programme.title: CSI S7, Ep 1

Dengan menggabungkan analisis ilmiah, pengamatan yang teliti, dan pengalaman investigasi, mereka berusaha merekonstruksi kejadian, menemukan tersangka, dan mengungkap kebenaran di balik setiap kasus.

programme.title: Po-Stagram Season 2

programme.title: Cocomelon English
programme.desc: Pelajari huruf, angka, suara binatang, dan lainnya dengan JJ dalam serial musik yang menghadirkan saat-saat menyenangkan dengan sajak anak-anak untuk seluruh keluarga

programme.title: Poyo Show
programme.desc: Rasakan kisah Pororo, Tayo dan Tittipo! Hari ini, apa yang akan terjadi pada teman-teman kita?

programme.title: Kertas Ajaib
programme.desc: Seri ini menyampaikan nilai-nilai persahabatan, keberanian, keyakinan dan pengampunan kepada anak-anak dan menceritakan kisah-kisah yang dialami Howie dan Landau di dasar laut. Howie, seorang penemu cilik dan Landau, seorang ahli pengetahuan kelautan, pergi ke laut dalam secara tidak sengaja. Mereka datang ke Kerajaan Merman dan terlibat dalam krisis besar di dunia laut.

programme.title: Pokemon Season 18
programme.desc: Saatnya Ash dan Pikachu memulai petualangan mereka di wilayah Kalos! Sepanjang jalan, mereka bergabung dengan beberapa teman baru seorang penemu jenius bernama Clemont, adik perempuannya Bonnie, dan Serena, seorang Pelatih dalam perjalanan pertamanya. Ash segera mencoba menantang Gym di Lumiose City, tetapi tidak terlalu jauh sebelum robot mengusirnya! Di sela-sela pertarungan Gym, Ash dan teman-temannya akan menjelajahi wilayah unik ini, bertemu semua jenis Pokemon baru, dan mencari misteri Pokemon baru yang menarik!

programme.title: Pororo Season 7
programme.desc: Mengisahkan tentang petualangan Pororo dan teman-temannya yang tinggal di desa bersalju Porong Porong Forest, yang sering menghadapi tantangan serta mempelajari pelajaran praktis dan moral dalam setiap episode.

programme.title: Tayo'S Healthy Habits
programme.desc: Halo Teman-teman~ Belajarlah untuk tumbuh menjadi anak yang sehat bersama Tayo. Mari belajar tentang pengendalian emosi, kebiasaan baik, dan keterampilan sosial bersama Tayo!

programme.desc: Tim sepak bola terhebat di dunia harus menghadapi tantangan baru, di mana bakat saja tak cukup dan setiap pertandingan penuh kejutan dari lawan.

programme.title: Masha & The Bear
programme.desc: Seekor beruang sirkus pensiunan menetap di hutan dan bersiap untuk kehidupan baru yang tenang dikelilingi oleh kedamaian dan ketenangan sampai dia diperkenalkan dengan seorang gadis kecil petualang bernama Masha. Masha adalah seorang gadis Rusia yang tinggal di hutan bersama babi, kambing, dan anjingnya.

programme.title: Bedu Dan Adul

programme.title: Tayo The Little Bus
programme.desc: Di kota besar di mana berbagai kendaraan hidup bahagia bersama, bus kecil Tayo baru saja mulai mempelajari rutenya di kota. Ada banyak lagi yang harus dipelajari untuk Tayo. Tayo dan teman-temannya yang ramah, Rogi, Lani, dan Gani saling membantu untuk menjadi bus dewasa yang hebat.

programme.title: Pesan Dari Surga (IMC)
programme.desc: Lima pemuda bergabung dalam grup band bernama Topeng. Suatu saat, terjadi masalah besar dan band ini terancam bubar. Namun, seorang korban kecelakaan yang tersadar dari koma datang dan membawa pesan dari surga.

programme.desc: 5 sahabat seumur hidup mencoba menyelamatkan seorang gadis yang sedang dalam kesulitan dari gangster dan zombi dalam komedi penuh aksi ini.

programme.desc: Pamela yang terobsesi dengan kecantikan menggunakan ilmu gaib berupa pelet dengan celana dalam pria sebagai medianya. Ia pun harus bersekutu dengan iblis agar dapat menguasai pelet tersebut.

programme.title: Kabut Sutra Ungu
programme.desc: Menggambarkan penderitaan dan ketabahan seorang janda bernama Miranti yang berusaha keras untuk hidup mandiri di tengah masalah dalam menghadapi kakak iparnya, Dimas, yang jatuh cinta padanya.

programme.title: Blok M
programme.desc: Film ini menceritakan kisah persahabatan Lola dan Cindy yang kerap berkumpul di Blok M untuk menceritakan problematika hidup mereka masing-masing.

programme.title: Cowok Bikin Pusing
programme.desc: Film ini menceritakan dua anak muda yang pernah disakiti oleh pasangan masing-masing. Mereka saling jatuh cinta dan harus menghadapi rintangan yang mengancam hubungan mereka.

programme.title: Abdullah Dan Takeshi
programme.desc: Sebuah kisah tentang dua anak laki-laki yang tertukar saat lahir di sebuah rumah sakit di Jepang. Bayi keturunan Arab dibesarkan oleh keluarga Jepang, sedangkan bayi keturunan Jepang dibesarkan oleh keluarga Arab.

programme.title: 2 Dari 3 Laki-Laki
programme.desc: Sebuah seminar tentang Pria dan Kesetiaan yang menyimpulkan bahwa dua dari tiga pria berselingkuh menjadi topik hangat. Hal ini pun membuat Doddy, seorang suami yang setia, dicurigai melakukan perselingkuhan.

programme.title: Dari Pintu Ke Pintu
programme.desc: Film ini bercerita tentang para pramuniagawati yang bekerja dengan jujur, sementara yang lain memanfaatkan pekerjaan mereka sebagai sebuah kedok untuk melancarkan sejumlah aksi kriminal.

programme.title: Mencari Hilal
programme.desc: Mahmud, seorang pria sepuh penuh keyakinan, ingin menghidupkan kembali tradisi lama untuk menegaskan makna ibadah. Namun perjalanannya bersinggungan dengan sang anak, membuka ruang bagi benturan dan kemungkinan damai.

programme.title: Toilet 105 (IMC)
programme.desc: Seorang siswi pindahan pindah ke sekolah baru setelah pindah ke Indonesia, di mana dia dan para siswa lainnya diganggu oleh anomali supernatural aneh di kamar mandi sekolah.

programme.title: 100% Halal (IMC)
programme.desc: Saat ia baru belajar memupuk cinta, Anisa Santosa, yang baru saja menikah muda dengan Putra Alfatih, suami pilihan ayahnya, Ilham Santosa.

programme.title: Serbuan Halilintar
programme.desc: Film ini bercerita tentang Yulia dan Hendra melawan Ganda beserta komplotannya, yang berniat merebut posisi kepala desa dengan membuat kekacauan dan pembantaian.

programme.title: Paku
programme.desc: Fahmi membesarkan putranya seorang diri setelah istrinya tewas usai melahirkan. Ia pun memutuskan untuk menghidupkan kembali istrinya menggunakan ilmu hitam, yaitu dengan menancapkan paku ke tengkorak sang istri.

programme.title: Boneka Dari Indiana
programme.desc: Film komedi yang menceritakan seorang suami bernama Egy yang berada di bawah kekuasaan istrinya, Cece. Namun akhirnya, Egy memberontak dan memutuskan untuk berhenti menjadi 'boneka'.

programme.desc: "POKEMON MASTER JOURNEYS" ADALAH SALAH SATU SERI TERBARU DALAM FRANCHISE POKEMON YANG MELANJUTKAN PERJALANAN ASH KETCHUM SEBAGAI PELATIH POKEMON. SERI INI MENAMPILKAN PETUALANGAN ASH BERSAMA DENGAN TEMANNYA, PIKACHU, DALAM MENJELAJAHI BERBAGAI WILAYAH POKEMON YANG BERBEDA. MEREKA BERTEMU DENGAN BERBAGAI PELATIH POKEMON BARU, MENANTANG GYM LEADERS, DAN MENGHADAPI TIM ROCKET YANG SELALU INGIN MENCURI POKEMON. SALAH SATU FOKUS UTAMA DARI "POKEMON MASTER JOURNEYS" ADALAH PENJELAJAHAN DUNIA POKEMON YANG LUAS. ASH DAN TEMAN-TEMANNYA BERTUJUAN UNTUK MENGHADIRI WORLD CORONATION SERIES, SEBUAH KOMPETISI BESAR DI MANA MEREKA BERUSAHA UNTUK MENJADI JUARA POKEMON MASTER. DI SEPANJANG PERJALANAN MEREKA, MEREKA BERTEMU DENGAN POKEMON LEGENDARIS, MENGHADAPI TANTANGAN BARU, DAN BELAJAR LEBIH BANYAK TENTANG DUNIA POKEMON. SERI INI JUGA MENGEKSPLORASI DINAMIKA ANTARA ASH, PIKACHU, DAN KARAKTER-KARAKTER LAIN YANG MEREKA TEMUI DALAM PETUALANGAN MEREKA. DENGAN FOKUS PADA PERTUMBUHAN, PERSAHABATAN, DAN KEKUATAN TIM, "POKEMON MASTER JOURNEYS" MENYAJIKAN PETUALANGAN YANG SERU DAN PENUH DENGAN KEJUTAN BAGI PARA PENGGEMAR POKEMON.

programme.title: Keluarga Somat
programme.desc: Keluarga Somat

programme.title: KELUARGA SOMAT
programme.desc: KELUARGA SOMAT MENCERITAKAN BAHWA KITA HIDUP HARUS SALING BERDAMPINGAN DAN MEMBANTU SATU SAMA LAIN SEBAGAI MASYARAKAT MAUPUN PELAJAR.

programme.title: PLENTIS KENTUS
programme.desc: PLENTIS KENTUS ADALAH SEBUAH ANIMASI ANAK-ANAK ASAL INDONESIA YANG POPULER DENGAN LAGU-LAGU CERIA DAN PENUH SEMANGAT. MEREKA DICIPTAKAN SEBAGAI BENTUK INOVASI DALAM INDUSTRI MUSIK ANAK-ANAK DI INDONESIA. PLENTIS DAN KENTUS ADALAH DUA SAHABAT KARIB YANG MASIH DUDUK DI BANGKU SEKOLAH DASAR. KEDUANYA MEMILIKI MIMPI BESAR UNTUK MENJADI PENYANYI TERKENAL. MEREKA SUKA BERNYANYI, MENCIPTAKAN LAGU, DAN TAMPIL DI BERBAGAI ACARA. PETUALANGAN MEREKA PENUH DENGAN KESERUAN, PERSAHABATAN, DAN TENTU SAJA, BANYAK SEKALI LAGU-LAGU YANG BISA MEMBUAT ANAK-ANAK IKUT BERNYANYI DAN BERGOYANG.

programme.title: BEDU DAN ADUL
programme.desc: BEDU DAN ADUL ADALAH SEBUAH SERIAL FILM ANIMASI 3D TENTANG PETUALANGAN ANAK-ANAK DI KAWASAN PINGGIRAN JAKARTA YANG MULTIKULTURAL. KARAKTER ANAK YANG SELALU INGIN TAHU MEMBUAT MEREKA INGIN SELALU BEREKSPLORASI HINGGA KADANG MENIMBULKAN KEHEBOHAN

programme.title: MADUN
programme.desc: Serial madun menceritakan perjalanan hidup madun (16 tahun) dalam memperjuangkan cita-citanya menjadi pesepakbola. Ayahnya, syafei (50 tahun) keturunan medan sangat menginginkan anaknya menjadi ustadz. Karena itu. Syafei selalu menghalangi upaya madun mencapai cita-citanya itu. baginya, pilihan madun hanya satu. Yakni jadi ahli agama. Ibunya madun, yaitu kirana asli batavia serba salah, dia harus patuh pada suami anti bola. Namun di sisi lain ia juga tidak ingin menghalangi madun mewujudkan cita-citanya. Ia tak tega mengekang madun yang mencintai bola. Namun untuk mewujudkan mimpinya. madun menghadapi banyak persaingan.

programme.title: Just For Laughs
programme.desc: Sebuah acara komedi bisu Kanada yang dibuat oleh grup Just For Laughs. Acara ini menampilkan orang-orang yang dijebak dalam berbagai situasi aneh oleh para aktor sementara sebuah kamera tersembunyi merekam reaksi mereka.

programme.title: COCOMELON IND
programme.desc: Animasi dan lagu 3d berbahasa indonesia, cocomelon menciptakan dunia yang berpusat pada pengalaman sehari-hari anak kecil. selain membantu anak-anak prasekolah mempelajari huruf, angka, suara binatang, warna, dan banyak lagi. video tersebut memberikan pelajaran kehidupan prososial. memberi orang tua kesempatan untuk mengajar dan bermain dengan anak-anak mereka saat mereka menonton bersama.

programme.title: NUMBERBLOCKS
programme.desc: Numberblocks adalah serial animasi pendidikan untuk anak-anak prasekolah yang mengajarkan konsep matematika melalui karakter blok angka yang hidup dan berpetualang. Setiap blok angka memiliki nilai numeriknya sendiri dan memiliki kepribadian yang unik. mereka bergabung dan berinteraksi satu sama lain untuk memecahkan masalah matematika sambil mengajarkan konsep dasar matematika seperti penjumlahan, pengurangan, perkalian, pembagian, dan konsep lainnya. Setiap episode dari "numberblocks" biasanya menampilkan cerita pendek di mana blok angka bekerja sama untuk menyelesaikan suatu tugas atau menghadapi tantangan matematika. Melalui lagu-lagu, cerita-cerita yang menarik, dan visual yang cerah, serial ini bertujuan untuk memperkenalkan dan memperkuat pemahaman anak-anak tentang angka dan konsep matematika dasar dengan cara yang menyenangkan dan interaktif.

programme.title: Kiko
programme.desc: Kiko, seekor anak ikan mas koki yang sangat mandiri, walaupun ia anak tunggal. programme.title: Terkepo-Kepo

programme.title: Ijin, Ndan !
programme.desc: Ijin, Ndan Adalah Program Crimetainment Yang Menggabungkan Informasi Seputar Kejahatan Dan Kriminalitas Dengan Sketsa Komedi Situasional Yang Berlatar Di Ruang Interogasi Atau Kantor Polisi. Dipandu Oleh Tiga Host Utama Yaitu Komandan Zack, Bro Dim, Dan Miss Binal, Setiap Episodenya Juga Menghadirkan Berbagai Cameo Menarik Seperti Tahanan, Petugas Kebersihan, Hingga Karakter Unik Lainnya Yang Menambah Keseruan. programme.title: Ternyata Ini Cinta (RCTI)

programme.title: Layar Drama Indonesia : Terikat Janji
programme.desc: Davina Rosalia Kusuma, putri pengusaha, tampak hidup sempurna namun menyimpan luka sejak ibunya meninggal dan ayahnya menikah lagi. Ia merasa terasing, terlebih setelah cinta pertamanya, Ryan, menghilang. Sepuluh tahun kemudian, pertunangannya dengan Dipa hancur karena perselingkuhan dengan adik tirinya, Jihan. Di tengah keterpurukan, Davina bertemu Sena, penjual ketoprak yang ternyata polisi intel yang menyelidiki Dipa. Tanpa ia tahu, Sena juga mencari kebenaran tentang hilangnya Ryanmembawa mereka pada rahasia, balas dendam, dan perasaan yang tak terduga.

programme.title: Terikat Janji (RCTI)

programme.title: Samudra Cinta

programme.title: Hot Door Night
programme.desc: Diproduksi oleh Sanlih E-Television, Hot Door Night merupakan salah satu acara variety paling populer di Taiwan. Dipandu oleh Jacky Wu bersama Chen Han-Dian dan Lulu Huang, setiap episode menghadirkan bintang tamu dari dunia hiburan untuk mengikuti berbagai permainan kreatif, tantangan bertema, penampilan musik, hingga segmen komedi yang mengundang tawa. Dengan perpaduan hiburan, kompetisi, dan interaksi spontan antar selebritas, acara ini telah menjadi favorit pemirsa serta meraih berbagai penghargaan bergengsi, termasuk Golden Bell Awards.

programme.title: The Sound Of Happiness
programme.desc: The Sound of Happiness mengisahkan keluarga Wu yang dipimpin oleh seorang perwira polisi beserta istrinya. Meski awalnya berharap memiliki seorang putra, mereka justru dikaruniai empat anak perempuan yang masing-masing menghadapi perjalanan hidup dan kisah cinta yang berbeda. Seiring berjalannya waktu, keluarga ini harus menghadapi berbagai konflik, mulai dari perselingkuhan, persaingan, ambisi, hingga rahasia yang menguji hubungan mereka. Di tengah berbagai cobaan tersebut, kasih sayang keluarga dan tekad untuk saling melindungi menjadi kekuatan utama dalam menghadapi setiap tantangan kehidupan.

programme.title: The Tradition Story Of Taiwan
programme.desc: The Tradition Story of Taiwan menyajikan berbagai kisah legenda, cerita rakyat, adat istiadat, kepercayaan tradisional, dan sejarah lokal yang membentuk identitas budaya Taiwan. Setiap episode mengungkap asal-usul tradisi, tokoh legendaris, perayaan budaya, hingga nilai-nilai yang diwariskan dari generasi ke generasi. Dengan perpaduan narasi, kunjungan ke lokasi bersejarah, dan eksplorasi budaya masyarakat setempat, program ini menghadirkan wawasan mendalam mengenai kekayaan warisan budaya Taiwan.

programme.title: Stylish Man: The Chef
programme.desc: Stylish Man: The Chef adalah salah satu program memasak paling populer di Taiwan yang telah menghibur pemirsa sejak 2006. Dipandu oleh Sam Tseng dan Genie Chuo bersama chef profesional James dan Wu Bing-Cheng, setiap episode menghadirkan demonstrasi memasak, kompetisi kuliner, tantangan bertema, serta kehadiran bintang tamu dari kalangan selebritas. Selain menyuguhkan hiburan yang ringan dan penuh humor, acara ini juga membagikan berbagai resep, teknik memasak, dan tips praktis yang dapat diterapkan di rumah.

programme.desc: Jeong Ha menjalin hubungan rahasia dengan Ji Seon. Saat Jin U datang dengan Jenny dan mengumumkan rencana menikah, berbagai rahasia keluarga terungkap hingga akhirnya mereka berpisah dengan saling memahami.

programme.title: Concrete Utopia (TVN Movies)
programme.desc: Kota Seoul yang telah hancur akibat gempa bumi, menyisakan satu apartemen yang masih berdiri. Perwakilan penghuni apartemen berusaha keras untuk melindungi penghuni lainnya dari orang luar.

programme.title: Missing You (tvN Movies)
programme.desc: Seorang gadis kecil yang kehilangan ayahnya karena seorang pembunuh berantai 15 tahun yang lalu menunggu pembebasannya, sementara seorang detektif yang dicurigai mengikuti si pembunuh setelah dibebaskan.

programme.title: The Snitch (tvN Movies)
programme.desc: Dalam lingkaran kejahatan narkoba, informan 'Ya-Dang' menjual informasi kriminal. Penjahat menggunakannya untuk mengurangi hukuman, sementara penegak hukum menggunakannya untuk penangkapan. Ya-Dang, polisi, dan jaksa membentuk segitiga kunci.

programme.title: The First Ride
programme.desc: Empat sahabat seumur hidup—Tae Jeong, Do Jin, Yeon Min, dan Geum Bok—bermimpi melakukan perjalanan epik ke luar negeri, tetapi kehidupan menghalangi. Bertahun-tahun kemudian, lebih tua tetapi belum tentu lebih bijak, mereka akhirnya memulai perjalanan yang sudah lama tertunda.

programme.title: Samjin Company English Class
programme.desc: Pada pertengahan tahun 1990-an di Korea Selatan, tiga pegawai wanita yang mendaftar ke kelas Bahasa Inggris dengan harapan dapat memajukan karier mereka, berjuang untuk mengungkap korupsi di dalam perusahaan mereka.

programme.title: Steel Rain: Summit
programme.desc: Pertemuan perdamaian untuk Korea gagal saat pemimpin Korea Selatan, Korea Utara, dan Amerika Serikat diculik dan disandera di sebuah kapal selam oleh sekelompok ekstremis Korea Utara.

programme.title: Mercenary for Justice
programme.desc: A gang of gold-hunting outlaws, headed by the ruthless Left Eye Watkins (Bobby Brown), takes over the peaceful town of Flatridge, tearing the sleepy outpost to shreds as they search for riches. They murder a can-can girl, who is the sister of Rachel (Monica Calhoun), the onetime leader of a notorious all-girl gang. Rachel then rounds up her four old associates, and they seek revenge for her sister. Using teamwork and a sassy attitude, Rachel's gang goes up against Watkins' tough crew.

programme.title: Fullmetal Alchemist: Brotherhood : E54 Beyond the Inferno [English Dub]
programme.desc: At a time when the industrial revolution was carrying the world into the modern age, a horde of undead monsters suddenly appeared. They could not be killed unless their hearts, which were protected by a layer of iron, were pierced. Humans bitten by them would come back as undead monsters themselves. These undead, which would later be known as "Kabane," exploded in population until they finally overran the world. The people of Hinomoto, a nation in the far east, built fortresses known as "stations" throughout the land that have allowed them to survive the threat of the Kabane. People can only travel between these stations using fortified steam locomotives known as "Hayajiro," and they have managed to stay alive by sharing resources in this way. Ikoma is a young steamsmith living at Aragane Station, a city that specializes in the manufacture of iron and steam engines. He is working on developing a unique anti-Kabane weapon called a "piercing gun" as he waits for his chance to prove his strength. Then, one day, a Hayajiro called the "Iron Fortress" makes its way through the front lines to arrive at Aragane Station. When Ikoma begins his usual maintenance routine, he sees a mysterious girl who is exempt from her Kabane inspection. That night, Ikoma sees the girl again and learns that her name is Mumei, but then an out-of-control Hayajiro overrun by Kabane charges into Aragane Station. The Kabane pour out of the train into Aragane Station. Ikoma races against the flow of the panicked residents, this time determined not to run away, but to defeat the Kabane with his piercing gun!

These undead, which would later be known as "Kabane," exploded in population until they finally overran the world. The people of Hinomoto, a nation in the far east, built fortresses known as "stations" throughout the land that have allowed them to survive the threat of the Kabane. People can only travel between these stations using fortified steam locomotives known as "Hayajiro," and they have managed to stay alive by sharing resources in this way. Ikoma is a young steamsmith living at Aragane Station, a city that specializes in the manufacture of iron and steam engines. He is working on developing a unique anti-Kabane weapon called a "piercing gun" as he waits for his chance to prove his strength. Then, one day, a Hayajiro called the "Iron Fortress" makes its way through the front lines to arrive at Aragane Station. When Ikoma begins his usual maintenance routine, he sees a mysterious girl who is exempt from her Kabane inspection. That night, Ikoma sees the girl again and learns that her name is Mumei, but then an out-of-control Hayajiro overrun by Kabane charges into Aragane Station. The Kabane pour out of the train into Aragane Station. Ikoma races against the flow of the panicked residents, this time determined not to run away, but to defeat the Kabane with his piercing gun!

programme.title: Before I Go To Sleep [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Ever since a vicious attack nearly claimed her life, Christine Lucas (Nicole Kidman) has suffered from anterograde amnesia and is unable to form new memories. Every morning, she becomes reacquainted with her husband, Ben (Colin Firth), and the other constants in her life. In accordance with her doctor's (Mark Strong) instructions, Christine keeps a video diary. As Christine starts to uncover terrifying truths about her past, she begins to question everything -- and everyone -- around her.

programme.title: I'm Charlie Walker [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: In 1971 two oil tankers collide off the coast of San Francisco, spilling millions of gallons of crude oil and creating an environmental disaster. Against all odds, trucking and construction entrepreneur Charlie Walker secures a lucrative contract to clean the coastline. However, he also finds himself fighting institutional racism from the very company that hired him.

programme.title: Honest Thief
programme.desc: Wanting to lead an honest life, a notorious bank robber (Liam Neeson) turns himself in, only to be double-crossed by two ruthless FBI agents.

programme.title: My Baby Gone
programme.desc: Pregnant Emily bonds quickly with her pregnant neighbor Kelly, but Kelly is faking it and plans to steal Emily's baby.

programme.title: Cold Blood
programme.desc: A legendary retired hit man (Jean Reno) lives in isolation in the barren North American wilderness. When he rescues a woman from a snowmobiling accident, he soon discovers that she's harboring a secret that forces him to return to his lethal ways.

programme.title: The Contract
programme.desc: Frank Carden (Morgan Freeman), one of the world's greatest assassins, is handed a lucrative contract to kill a highly secretive billionaire. But in a twist of fate, Carden is involved in a car accident during the job, and when his gun is found after he is admitted to a hospital, federal marshals arrest him. Meanwhile, ex-cop Ray Keene (John Cusack) is hiking with his son, Chris (Jamie Anderson), when Carden's cohorts try to spring him from custody, and soon the pair is caught in the crossfire.

programme.title: Direct Contact
programme.desc: An American prisoner in a Russian jail is given a chance at freedom if he can rescue a kidnapped woman.

programme.title: My Mom's New Boyfriend
programme.desc: After several years away, FBI agent Henry Durand (Colin Hanks) returns to find his mother, Marty (Meg Ryan), a much different person: Having long mourned for Henry's father, she is now embracing single life. One day, while Marty, Henry and his new fiancée, Emily (Selma Blair), are out for a walk, they meet Tommy (Antonio Banderas), a mysterious stranger, with whom Marty then becomes involved. However, through his FBI contacts, Henry learns that Tommy is suspected of being an art thief.

programme.title: Before I Go To Sleep [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Ever since a vicious attack nearly claimed her life, Christine Lucas (Nicole Kidman) has suffered from anterograde amnesia and is unable to form new memories. Every morning, she becomes reacquainted with her husband, Ben (Colin Firth), and the other constants in her life. In accordance with her doctor's (Mark Strong) instructions, Christine keeps a video diary. As Christine starts to uncover terrifying truths about her past, she begins to question everything -- and everyone -- around her.

programme.title: Mercenary for Justice
programme.desc: As a mercenary, John Seeger (Steven Seagal) has a reputation that precedes him. That's why he's being blackmailed into performing a risky job: breaking the son of a wealthy arms dealer out of a South African prison. With his friends taken hostage, Seeger agrees to do the deed -- but finds out too late that he's been double-crossed. Not one who likes being taken for a fool, Seeger hatches an elaborate plan to get even that will make the prison break look like capture the flag.

programme.title: The Long Walk Home
programme.desc: Odessa Cotter needs to get to work as a nanny in the home of the affluent Miriam Thompson, but she refuses to take the bus. Odessa is participating in the Montgomery bus boycott, protesting against the inequality between blacks and whites, so Miriam decides to offer Odessa a ride to work every day. Though the community and Miriam's husband insist she not get involved, the relationship between Miriam and Odessa has already changed for the better.

programme.title: Heathers [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Veronica (Winona Ryder) is part of the most popular clique at her high school, but she disapproves of the other girls' cruel behavior. When Veronica and her new boyfriend, J.D. (Christian Slater), confront clique leader Heather Chandler (Kim Walker) and accidentally poison her, they make it appear a suicide. Soon Veronica realizes that J.D. is intentionally killing students he does not like. She races to stop J.D. while also clashing with the clique's new leader, Heather Duke (Shannen Doherty).

programme.title: Animal Factory [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Suburbanite Ron (Edward Furlong) is spoiled, young and not overly worried about the marijuana charges leveled against him. But, after being made out to be a drug dealer, he faces a five-year jail sentence in San Quentin State Prison. Physically frail and unaccustomed to his rough surroundings, Ron is primed to fall victim to sexual predators and bullying guards -- that is, until he's befriended by Earl (Willem Dafoe), a veteran inmate who finds meaning in protecting the vulnerable new kid.

programme.title: Going All The Way [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Korean War--era veterans and ex-classmates "Gunner" Casselman (Ben Affleck) and "Sonny" Burns (Jeremy Davies) reunite upon their return home. Gunner, who spent the war years abroad, is trying to convince his mother that his gal Marty (Rachel Weisz) is good enough for him, while Sonny, who was stationed stateside, is torn between loyal Buddy (Amy Locane) and tempting Gale Ann (Rose McGowan). As they commiserate, the men realize that they're outgrowing the lives they lived before the war.

programme.title: Eye See You
programme.desc: Recovering from the psychological effects of witnessing a brutal crime, FBI Agent Jake Malloy (Sylvester Stallone) checks into a rehabilitation clinic for law enforcement officers in the remote wilderness of Wyoming during the dead of winter. He soon finds himself helping other patients as a serial killer begins killing them one by one.

When Wesley proposes cutting Johnny in on a criminal undertaking, Johnny must choose between a life of crime and a settled future with Ruby.

programme.desc: Rookie finds a large library and is fascinated and attracted by all the colorful books. programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.desc: On his tour, Rookie discovers a small cow trapped in a pit and unable to escape on its own. He quickly rushes to its rescue and lifts it to safety. programme.title: Georgia Rule
programme.desc: Teenage Rachel (Lindsay Lohan) is a real thorn in the side of her mother, Lilly (Felicity Huffman). More than just rebellious, she is incorrigible. After Rachel crashes a car, Lilly decides to haul the girl off to a place to which she vowed never to return: Her own mother's (Jane Fonda) Idaho home. Georgia, the family matriarch, lives by a strict code and expects all under her roof to do the same. Given structure and purpose, Rachel's anger at the world begins to subside.

programme.title: Fatal Instinct
programme.desc: Ned Ravine (Armand Assante) is a police officer and lawyer who occasionally defends the delinquents he arrests. He crosses paths with a seductive femme fatale, Lola Cain (Sean Young), during an assignment and promptly begins an affair with her. Meanwhile, Ned's wife, Lana (Kate Nelligan), is deep in an affair of her own. Lana and her lover, Frank (Christopher McDonald), are planning to murder Ned in an elaborate fashion so they can collect on his triple indemnity life insurance policy.

programme.title: She-Devil
programme.desc: Housewife and mother Ruth Patchett (Roseanne Barr), an overweight and unkempt woman, can seem to do nothing to make her husband, Bob (Ed Begley Jr.), happy. When he becomes embroiled in an affair with romance novelist Mary Fisher (Meryl Streep), Patchett does all she can to ignore it until Bob finally leaves her for Fisher. Bent on revenge, Patchett begins an intricate undertaking that will lead to the destruction of all that Bob holds dear -- and she also has plans for Fisher while she's at it.

programme.desc: An actor (Morgan Freeman) who is considering the role of a supermarket manager arrives at a grocery store on the outskirts of Los Angeles to do some field research. He subsequently becomes stranded, without a car or cell phone, and accepts a ride home with Scarlet (Paz Vega), a cashier who is about to interview for a new job. The actor rediscovers the essence of his craft while helping Scarlet gain the confidence she needs to change her life.

programme.title: Mannequin Two: On the Move
programme.desc: Although Jason (William Ragsdale) works as a department store clerk, he is also a reincarnated prince. Long ago, his beloved Jessie (Kristy Swanson) was snatched away from him by an evil wizard (Terry Kiser) who used his powers to transform her into wooden statue. Now Jessie is in Jason's department store as a mannequin. When he encounters her, she awakens from her thousand-year sleep. They quickly revive their romance, but the evil wizard has been reincarnated as well, and he's up to no good.

Naturally, the company doesn't want to lose one of their prize assets, so the ruthless Daniel Bench (Billy Drago) is sent to track Cash down.

With resources scarce, Kesslee (Malcolm McDowell) -- head of the powerful and evil Water & Power Corporation, the de facto government -- has taken control of the water supply. Unwilling to cower under Kesslee's tyrannical rule, a pair of outlaws known as Tank Girl (Lori Petty) and Jet Girl (Naomi Watts) rise up, joining the mysterious rebel Rippers to destroy the corrupt system.

While trying to discover the cult's secrets, she becomes a victim herself. Sadie awakes in the morgue with an insatiable craving for blood and revenge, so she joins forces with a grieving detective (Michael Chiklis) to destroy the undead creatures once and for all.

When she's discovered by three vampire hunters, Vladimir (Michael Madsen), Katarin (Michelle Rodriguez) and Sebastian (Matt Davis), she manages to convince them to spare her life and join her cause. But slaying a vampire as powerful as Kagan will be no easy task.

Husband Georg (Ulrich Mühe) comes to her rescue, but Paul and Peter take the family hostage and subject them to nightmarish abuse and humiliation. From time to time, Paul talks to the film's audience, making it complicit in the horror.

programme.title: The Stunt Man

When he inadvertently causes a stuntman's death, the film's manipulative director, Eli Cross (Peter O'Toole), decides to shelter Cameron from the cops if he steps in as the daredevil's replacement. Though the arrangement seems like a good deal, it soon becomes a perilous position, with the situation only complicated when Cameron falls for the movie's lead actress, Nina Franklin (Barbara Hershey).

programme.title: Serving Sara

programme.title: Winter Kills
programme.desc: Inspired by the conspiracy theories surrounding John F. Kennedy's assassination, this comic thriller follows Nick Kegan (Jeff Bridges), the younger brother of a U.S. president killed 19 years earlier. After finding a man claiming to be his brother's second assassin, Nick begins an intricate investigation into the secrets behind the murder. But Nick runs into trouble when his controlling father (John Huston) tries to keep him from uncovering the truth.

programme.title: If... Dog... Rabbit

programme.title: The Rookies

programme.title: Compromising Positions

programme.title: Jobs

Built in the garage of Jobs' parents, the device -- and the subsequent formation of Apple Inc. -- have changed the world for all time. Though he is viewed as a visionary, Jobs' tenure as Apple's leader is a rocky one, leading to his eventual ouster from the company he co-founded.

In "Nancy's Last Dance," Nancy Callahan (Jessica Alba), mad with grief and rage over Hartigan's death, vows revenge.

However, the financial difficulties faced by his mother, Jewel (Brenda Blethyn), who is also a prostitute, make escaping his former life difficult. With few job prospects, Sonny reluctantly begins working the streets. The only bright spot in his otherwise difficult life is his relationship with Carol (Mena Suvari), Jewel's new protégé.

programme.title: Song to Song

programme.title: Bright Young Things

Among the group is the aspiring novelist Adam Fenwick-Symes, who is attempting to raise enough money to marry fellow member Nina Blount. However, after customs officials confiscate his first manuscript, Fenwick-Symes must recover from the financial setback and figure out new ways to earn money for a wedding.

programme.title: The Killing Time

The killer assumes the identity of the dead man and shows up in the beach town, where he's accepted as a new lawman. Meanwhile, the town's sheriff, Sam (Beau Bridges), plans to knock off the husband of his secret lover. Sam thinks his new deputy will make the perfect fall guy, but he doesn't know he's dealing with a dangerous man.

programme.title: Breakfast of Champions

programme.title: Eastern Promises
programme.desc: Nikolai (Viggo Mortensen), who is both ruthless and mysterious, has ties to one of the most dangerous crime families in London. He crosses paths with Anna (Naomi Watts), a midwife who has come across potentially damaging evidence against the family, which forces him to set in motion a plan of deceit, death and retribution.

programme.title: Fighting
programme.desc: Shawn MacArthur (Channing Tatum) barely makes a living selling counterfeit goods on the streets of New York. But he has a natural talent for street fighting, which con-man Harvey Boarden (Terrence Howard) wants to put to good use. Forming an uneasy alliance with Boarden, Shawn becomes top dog in the bare-knuckle-brawl circuit, taking down pro boxers, martial artists and ultimate fighters one by one. Shawn wants out of this dark world, but he faces the fight of his life to get there.

programme.title: Conan the Destroyer
programme.desc: In his second cinematic adventure, the mighty warrior Conan (Arnold Schwarzenegger) is tricked into working for the scheming Queen Taramis (Sarah Douglas). Along with finding a mystical horn, Conan and his allies, which include the fierce fighter, Zula (Grace Jones), and the wisecracking sorcerer, Akiro (Mako), must protect the beautiful young Princess Jehnna (Olivia d'Abo). With deception and danger at every turn, Conan has to use all of his power to defeat the evil foes that stand in his way.

programme.title: Kull the Conqueror
programme.desc: After five years as a slave, warrior Kull travels to the shores of the fantastical kingdom of Valusia, where he slays mad King Borna. Inheriting the crown, Kull begins an ambitious program of bringing freedom and tolerance to Valusia, which displeases Gen. Taligaro and the royal court's advisers. Determined to unseat Kull, Taligaro has a wizard resurrect the witch Akivasha to seduce and destroy the new monarch.

programme.title: The Hunted
programme.desc: New York executive Paul Racine is on a business trip in Japan when he meets the stunning, enigmatic Kirina. They spend the night together in her hotel room, and Racine returns the next day to retrieve his forgotten keys. But once he's there, he witnesses Kirina's assassination by Kinjo, the leader of a ninja cult. Realizing that Racine has seen everything, Kinjo will do everything in his power to end the executive's life.

programme.title: They Live
programme.desc: Nada (Roddy Piper), a wanderer without meaning in his life, discovers a pair of sunglasses capable of showing the world the way it truly is. As he walks the streets of Los Angeles, Nada notices that both the media and the government are comprised of subliminal messages meant to keep the population subdued, and that most of the social elite are skull-faced aliens bent on world domination. With this shocking discovery, Nada fights to free humanity from the mind-controlling aliens.

programme.title: Tremors 4: The Legend Begins
programme.desc: Prim East Coast dandy Hiram Gummer (Michael Gross) arrives in the town of Rejection, Nev., to investigate a series of strange deaths at the silver mine he owns. He receives help from local innkeeper Christine Lord (Sara Botsford) and miner Juan Pedilla (Brent Roam). But, when it turns out that gigantic killer worms that burrow underground are responsible for the miners' deaths, Hiram decides he'd better call in expert gunslinger Black Hand Kelly (Billy Drago) to save the day.

programme.title: Tremors 5: Bloodlines
programme.desc: Survivalist Burt Gummer (Michael Gross) and his new sidekick Travis (Jamie Kennedy) are hired to track down an ass-blaster terrorizing South Africa. As they engage in battles with the aggressive creatures, they discover an even more lethal creature.

programme.title: Tremors: A Cold Day in Hell
programme.desc: Burt Gummer suspects that giant worms are being utilized as weapons at a research facility in Canada. He soon finds himself in a race against time to create an antidote from one of the creature's venom to save his own life.

programme.title: Tremors: Shrieker Island
programme.desc: Burt Gummer must save the day when a wealthy playboy unleashes a gigantic, carnivorous worm and other monsters on a tropical island.

programme.title: Child's Play 2
programme.desc: Two years after serial killer Charles Lee Ray (Brad Dourif) inserted his soul into a Chucky doll, a toy company attempts to re-create the doll, bringing Ray back in the process. The possessed doll, intent on claiming a human body, kills his way toward former owner Andy (Alex Vincent), who now lives in a foster home. Andy's foster sister, Kyle (Christine Elise), tries to protect him, but his foster parents believe Andy is just a troubled kid -- and Chucky's murderous path continues.

programme.title: Child's Play 3
programme.desc: It's been years since Chucky, the doll with the soul and the voice (Brad Dourif) of a psychopathic killer, was apparently destroyed in a fire at a doll factory. Now Chucky's manufacturer is remaking the same line of toys with the old, still haunted materials. This resurrects Chucky, who goes after Andy (Justin Whalin), his former owner, who now attends military school. Chucky slashes his way through a string of grotesque murders as Andy tries to stop the homicidal doll and the spirit within it.

programme.title: Bride of Chucky
programme.desc: After being cut apart by the police, killer doll Chucky (Brad Dourif) is resurrected by Tiffany (Jennifer Tilly), an ex-girlfriend of the serial murderer whose soul is inside the toy. Following an argument, Chucky kills Tiffany and transfers her soul into a bride doll. To find the magical amulet that can restore them both to human form, Chucky and Tiffany arrange to be driven to New Jersey by Jesse (Nick Stabile) and Jade (Katherine Heigl), who are unaware that their cargo is alive.

programme.desc: Chicago firefighting brothers Stephen (Kurt Russell) and Brian (William Baldwin) have been rivals since childhood. Brian, struggling to prove himself, transfers to the arson unit. There he aids Don (Robert De Niro) in his investigation into a spate of fires involving oxygen-induced infernos called backdrafts. But when a conspiracy implicating a crooked politician and an arsonist leads Brian back to Stephen, he is forced to overcome his brotherly competitiveness in order to crack the case.

The spectacular explosion that follows results in both ends of the tunnel collapsing and the handful of people who survived the explosion are now in peril. Kit Latura is the only man with the skill and knowledge to lead the band of survivors out of the tunnel before the structure collapses.

Guile (Jean-Claude Van Damme) leads an international strike force to invade Shadaloo and rescue the hostages. Along the way, Guile recruits Chun-Li (Ming-Na Wen), a reporter and martial-arts expert whose father was killed by Bison years ago, two young con men (Damian Chapa, Byron Mann) and a sumo wrestler (Peter Navy Tuiasosopo).

programme.title: Pitch Black

programme.title: My Week With Marilyn
programme.desc: In 1956 England, Colin Clark (Eddie Redmayne) lands a job as a production assistant on the set of "The Prince and the Showgirl," starring Marilyn Monroe (Michelle Williams). Marilyn is also honeymooning with her new husband, playwright Arthur Miller, but the combined pressure of work and the demands of the Hollywood hangers-on is driving her to exhaustion. When Miller departs for Paris, Colin seizes the opportunity, to give Marilyn respite during a week in the idyllic British countryside.

programme.title: Stranger Than Fiction
programme.desc: A mentally unstable IRS auditor (Will Ferrell) hears an author's (Emma Thompson) voice in his head and discovers that he is the ill-fated protagonist of her latest work. While a book-company employee (Queen Latifah) tries to cure the author's case of writer's block, the auditor and a professor (Dustin Hoffman) set out to find the woman and make her change her story.

programme.title: La La Land
programme.desc: Sebastian (Ryan Gosling) and Mia (Emma Stone) are drawn together by their common desire to do what they love. But as success mounts they are faced with decisions that begin to fray the fragile fabric of their love affair, and the dreams they worked so hard to maintain in each other threaten to rip them apart.

programme.title: Silver Linings Playbook
programme.desc: After losing his job and wife, and spending time in a mental institution, Pat Solatano winds up living with his parents. He wants to rebuild his life and reunite with his wife, but his parents would be happy if he just shared their obsession with the Philadelphia Eagles. Things get complicated when Pat meets Tiffany, who offers to help him reconnect with his wife, if he will do something very important for her in exchange.

programme.title: Hacksaw Ridge
programme.desc: The true story of Pfc. Desmond T. Doss (Andrew Garfield), who won the Congressional Medal of Honor despite refusing to bear arms during WWII on religious grounds. Doss was drafted and ostracized by fellow soldiers for his pacifist stance but went on to earn respect and adoration for his bravery, selflessness and compassion after he risked his life -- without firing a shot -- to save 75 men in the Battle of Okinawa.

programme.title: The Hurt Locker
programme.desc: Staff Sgt. William James (Jeremy Renner), Sgt. J.T. Sanborn (Anthony Mackie) and Specialist Owen Eldridge (Brian Geraghty) are members of a bomb-disposal unit in Baghdad. As their tour of duty enters its final weeks, the men face a set of increasingly hazardous situations, any of which could end their lives in an explosive instant.

programme.title: Midway
programme.desc: On Dec. 7, 1941, Japanese forces launch a devastating attack on Pearl Harbor, the U.S. naval base in Hawaii. Six months later, the Battle of Midway commences on June 4, 1942, as the Japanese navy once again plans a strike against American ships in the Pacific. For the next three days, the U.S. Navy and a squad of brave fighter pilots engage the enemy in one of the most important and decisive battles of World War II.

programme.title: Emperor
programme.desc: Following the Japanese surrender at the end of World War II, Gen. Bonner Fellers must determine whether Emperor Hirohito should be hanged as a war criminal.

programme.title: Deepwater Horizon
programme.desc: On April 20, 2010, the Deepwater Horizon drilling rig explodes in the Gulf of Mexico, igniting a massive fireball that kills several crew members. Chief electronics technician Mike Williams (Mark Wahlberg) and his colleagues find themselves fighting for survival as the heat and the flames become stifling and overwhelming. Banding together, the co-workers must use their wits to make it out alive amid all the chaos.

programme.title: Plane
programme.desc: Pilot Brodie Torrance saves passengers from a lightning strike by making a risky landing on a war-torn island -- only to find that surviving the landing was just the beginning. When dangerous rebels take most of the passengers hostage, the only person Torrance can count on for help is Louis Gaspare, an accused murderer who was being transported by the FBI.

programme.title: Molly's Game
programme.desc: The true story of Molly Bloom, a beautiful, young, Olympic-class skier who ran the world's most exclusive high-stakes poker game for a decade before being arrested in the middle of the night by 17 FBI agents wielding automatic weapons. Her players included Hollywood royalty, sports stars, business titans and finally, unbeknown to her, the Russian mob. Her only ally was her criminal defense lawyer Charlie Jaffey, who learned there was much more to Molly than the tabloids led people to believe.

programme.title: Continue
programme.desc: Convinced she's fated to walk the same troubled path as her father, Dean suffers a major mental health episode and is committed to a rehabilitation facility. Once confined, Dean shudders through the agonies of recovery, and bravely comes out the other side armed with a defense against the darkness, summed up in one word: Continue.

programme.title: The Best of Enemies
programme.desc: The true story of the unlikely relationship between Ann Atwater, an outspoken civil rights activist, and C.P. Ellis, a local Ku Klux Klan leader. During the racially charged summer of 1971, Atwater and Ellis come together to co-chair a community summit on the desegregation of schools in Durham, N.C. The ensuing debate and battle soon lead to surprising revelations that change both of their lives forever.

programme.desc: At 79, Heejin bids farewell to her husband Sunwoo, with whom she spent over 40 years. Desiring to meet her husband again, she encounters Sunwoo in his 30s form, restored as an AI through the Mind Upload system. In order to make the memory data more complete, Heejin awakens the unfamiliar ego of Sunwoo in a void state, and each time she connects, her husband's memories are reset to zero. As Heejin repeatedly meets with her husband while holding onto the memories alone, she gradually becomes exhausted. Separation, and Meeting: AI Memory Recovery Virtual World "Tomorrow's Today" In the near yet distant future, in the online funeral service ""Our Universe"" provided by AI, Sound, a space explorer, receives news of the death of her father, composer Kim Hyeongseok, while crossing the Sothell Galaxy. Adapting to the contactless era, Sound utilizes an online condolence service app that allows her to engage in video chats with the deceased, who have been uploaded by artificial intelligence, during the three-day funeral period. Invited to the online funeral, Sound's father Hyeongseok and his acquaintances begin to journey through memories together. Though her father was a famous composer, Sound, who always prioritized work, can only watch his actions without being able to offer words readily.

programme.desc: As each day passes, babies' awareness of the world around them -- and all the wonders it holds -- continues to develop. programme.title: Baby Einstein
programme.desc: Baby's innate curiosity about all they see and hear increases on a daily basis. Before long, they begin to associate words with objects and to imitate and articulate sounds. Why not give their eyes and ears something wonderful to feast upon? Baby Shakespeare presents little ones with 12 common words that can be found within the rich context of classic poems and the beauty of nature.

programme.title: Baby Einstein
programme.desc: Early on in babies' development, they begin to recognize primary colors such as blue, red, and yellow. And all the while, they're also processing an infinite variety of new sights and sounds. Think of the joy you'll experience as you introduce your little one to beautiful music and imagery with Baby Beethoven Symphony of Fun.

programme.title: Baby Einstein

programme.desc: Discover instruments through narration and repetition. Real-life images and sounds will engage viewers as they dance to upbeat classical favorites from Beethoven, Mozart and more. Join your favorite Baby Einstein characters to discover what makes each instrument unique!

programme.title: Baby Einstein

programme.title: Baby Einstein
programme.desc: From the moment babies are born, they use their developing senses to discover the world. In terms of sight, bold patterns in contrasting colors or black and white are initially preferred. As for sounds, Mother s gentle voice, in any language, is music to baby's ears. Language Nursery: Voices From Many Lands acquaints your baby with the sounds of foreign language by presenting delightful, visually stimulating images accompanied by spoken passages, natural sounds and music.

programme.title: Baby Einstein
programme.desc: Discover the exciting world of shapes and colors! Learn about the primary colors red, yellow, and blue with real-life imagery of animals and objects. Explore colors like purple, orange, and green and see artwork by Van Gogh! Discover the circles, squares, and triangles that surround us in everyday life, and introduce baby to the world of visual arts as children and artists create their own work!

programme.title: Baby Einstein
programme.sub-title: On the Go: Riding, Sailing and Soaring
programme.desc: As little ones become increasingly mobile, their fascination with all things that move intensifies too. programme.title: The Power Of Merlok
programme.desc: When Jestro attacks a village on the far side of the Kingdom, the NEXO-Knights wonder how they'll get there. Then Macy remembers her dad has a royal RV…maybe they can “mod” that for their own, “knightly” use? Now the NEXO-Knights get rolling…in THE FORTREX, their own ROLLING CASTLE! This great new HQ, which houses Merlok 2.0 as an operating system, will be how the knights move around Knighton and protect it from Jestro and his monsters. Speaking of the evil jester, in this episode Jestro uses some newly-made monsters to attack a town far from the capitol where he thinks he's safe from the Knights' reach. We see two parallel stories here: the Knights training, learning more about digital magic and getting organized as a team and at the same time we see Jestro making monsters, trying to learn how his powers work and talking to the Book. In the end, the Knights roll up in their castle and defeat Jestro and his marauding monsters. Lance thinks he should be the leader because he's a snot. “Of course I'm the leader…I'm a Richmond.”

programme.title: All Dogs Allowed
programme.desc: The girls plan a formal afternoon lawn party tea to inaugurate their new dog park. Plum is in charge of decorations, Cherry music, and Strawberry snacks. There's even a giant, dog-shaped ice sculpture. As the girls get dressed, Raspberry puts the finishing touches on the high-fashion hats that will accompany their beautiful gowns. At last everything is ready. But when the gate opens... the puppies back away! For some strange reason, they want nothing to do with the dog park! No matter how the girls call them to come in, the pups hesitate and back away, with worried whines. Cherry tries to tempt them by hiding doggie treats around the park, but the pups just run in, snatch the treats and run out. Debate begins about why the pups won't enter the park. Everyone has their own theory. Strawberry wonders if something is scaring them. Blueberry concludes it's Lemon's ice sculpture.

programme.title: The Littlest Berrykin
programme.desc: Blueberry and Huck turn the Baby Berrykins' favorite fairy tale, “The Littlest Berrykin,” into a comedy play. They pitch it to director Plum and the assembled cast and crew using a large storybook. As Huck and Blueberry narrate the story, we push in on the book and its illustrations transition into animation. In the story, the King and Queen of the Berry Patch (played by Huck and Blueberry) are retiring to the tropics. But before leaving, they must choose which of their three princesses (played by Lemon, Raspberry and Strawberry in royal gowns) will rule the kingdom.

programme.title: The Berry Big Relay Race
programme.desc: Orange wants to spend the day teaching her puppy to fetch, but the frisky little gal doesn't seem to understand the “retrieve” part of the activity—as soon as she gets the ball, she runs out of sight and returns moments later without it. Orange gets a new ball and tries again, with the same results. Over and over, until Orange is out of balls. Puzzled and frustrated that she can't find where her pup has stashed them, she goes to enlist her friends to help her search. Orange finds Strawberry, Plum and Raspberry in Lemon's salon, getting their hair and nails done, but something starts going terribly wrong with the appliances.
